dambal.summary: A mobile fitness platform for coaches and the people they train.
dambal.role: Full-Stack & Mobile Developer · Independent Product Developer
dambal.description: A launched fitness platform that connects coaches and users through a mobile app. Coaches manage training plans, while users follow their programs and engage with fitness content.
highlights: Designed and implemented the mobile app architecture and backend APIs.
Built coach and user workflows, authentication, authorization, and training plan management.
Implemented social content, engagement, search, and real-time notifications.
Prepared Android and iOS release builds.

drsinu.summary: A healthcare platform for service bookings, payments, and administration.
drsinu.description: A healthcare platform built around service reservations, payment integrations, financial workflows, and the tools administrators use to manage them.
highlights: Designed APIs and database structures for reservations and administrative operations.
Integrated payments and implemented the platform’s financial workflows.
Built administrative interfaces and background processing.
Worked on production deployment, infrastructure, and CI/CD.
